info.title: UAE B2B Marketplace API
info.description: Phase 1: identity, sessions, companies, verification, team and admin. Money is integer fils (AED); timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. Successful responses use { data, meta }; errors use { error: { code, message_key, field_errors?, request_id } }. Cross-tenant resources return 404.

companySession.name: sid
companySession.description: Company session cookie (__Host-sid in production). HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax.

adminSession.name: asid
adminSession.description: Admin session cookie on the admin origin only (__Host-asid in production). SameSite=Strict. Requires completed TOTP.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Must equal the csrf cookie on every POST/PATCH/DELETE; Origin must be the web origin (admin origin for /admin).
